I am an old woman here in Mbeya, and this small plot near the house is only a tiny piece, less than a quarter acre. I grow mixed things together on it — some beans with other crops — mostly for my family to eat. I have no money to buy chemical fertilizer or hybrid seeds, so I use the seeds I saved from last harvest and put the manure from my few animals and the kitchen ash on the soil. The rains in Mbeya are good, so I do not need to carry water, and I work the plot myself with my own hands, maybe my daughter helps sometimes when she comes.
